_comment: Synthetic merchant-portion golden vector (no real data). A flat list of {narration, expected_portion} pairs pinning the FR-027a derivation: normalise via dedup::normalize_narration (unchanged), split on the closed separator set (whitespace and - / \ | * : ; , # _ % ( ) [ ] " ', where @ and . are deliberately NOT separators), discard every segment that is empty, entirely digits, a mixed token carrying four or more digits, a single character, or a member of the closed stop-list (zero merchant names in it), then keep the first two survivors joined by one space; fewer than one survivor is null. Every narration here is synthetic and looks it -- there is no real VPA, no real UPI handle and no real account number in this repository (Constitution Principle I), which is also the limit of what this fixture can prove: it establishes that the rule is deterministic and stable across the shapes we have, NOT that it is adequate against the real diversity of Indian narrations (research R16). The four UPI-SWIGGY shapes and the two R15 limitation cases are carried verbatim from research R14/R15 so that this file fails the day either changes. 'covers' names the branch each case exists for.
